7 Days / 6 Nights

Spiti : The Highland Circuit (Moto Expedition)

Delhi — Manali — Kaza — Langza — Komic — Hikkim — Key Monastery — Chicham Bridge — Kunzum Pass — Chandratal — Manali — Delhi

About This Trip

Gear up for the ultimate Himalayan ride with Awara Banjara's Spiti Highland Circuit Motorbike Expedition. Starting with an overnight AC Volvo journey from Delhi to Manali, take the handlebars across treacherous passes, high-altitude alpine terrain, and remote Spiti villages including Langza, Komic, and Hikkim. Visit the magnificent Key Monastery, ride across Asia's highest bridge at Chicham, and camp near the mystical Chandratal Lake before riding back into Manali. Designed for passionate riders seeking high-octane adventure and iconic mountain landscapes.

Itinerary

Board a premium overnight Volvo coach departing from Delhi in the late evening. Relax in executive reclining seats on the overnight highway journey to Manali.

Arrive in Manali, check-in, meet your ride captain, receive your motorbike allocation, and go on a short local test ride for briefing.

Ride out from Manali across Atal Tunnel / Kunzum Pass into the rugged high-altitude desert terrain of Spiti Valley to reach Kaza.

Ride through high-altitude circuit routes visiting Langza (Fossil Village), Komic (highest motorable village), Hikkim (world's highest post office), Key Monastery, and Chicham Bridge.

Ride from Kaza over Kunzum Pass to reach the crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake for an overnight campsite stay under the stars.

Ride back from Chandratal to Manali, drop off your motorbikes, and board the evening overnight Volvo coach back to Delhi.

Reach Delhi in the morning with lifelong memories of your Spiti Moto Expedition.
